results.description:
Superpedestrian brings you the next generation of safe and thoughtful e-scooters. Whether you’re exploring a new place or getting to the office, Superpedestrian scooters are a fun, affordable, and convenient way to get around. Use the app to find a Superpedestrian scooter near you and experience the joy of one of our easy to ride two-wheelers. 

HOW TO RIDE
— Download the Superpedestrian app and make an account
— Explore the map to find a scooter near you
— Scan the scooter’s QR code or enter the scooter ID to unlock
— Ride safely and have fun
— Park respectfully
— End your ride in the app

SUPERPEDESTRIAN IS SPECIAL
— Designed with a low center of gravity for a smooth and safe ride
— Longer and wider deck for easier riding
— Superpedestrian scooters conduct 1,000+ safety checks before and during every ride
— Stops 37% faster with a triple braking system 
— Every Superpedestrian ride is 100% carbon neutral, certified by Climate Neutral

SAFETY TIPS
— We recommend always wearing a helmet
— Only one person per scooter
— You must be 18+ to ride
— Follow traffic laws and street signs
— Never ride under the influence

 PARK WITH CARE
— Use the kickstand to park upright
— Keep walkways clear
— Don’t block the curb, access ramps, doors, or loading docks
— Keep bus stops clear
— Don’t be that person, park respectfully 
 
We are located in 50+ cities across the globe, where we are replacing car trips and promoting healthy and safe mobility with our 100% carbon neutral scooters. Want to give us a go? Check out www.link.city/cities to find a Superpedestrian city near you!

The wait is over! We are stoked to introduce the all-new Apollo app. We took everything we loved about the original and rebuilt it from scratch to give you a fresh, faster experience. It is not just an update, it is a completely new foundation designed to get you on the road in fewer steps.

This version is all about making things easier for you. We redesigned the entire flow so you can get into your settings and start your rides way quicker than before. You can finally choose between Dark and Light modes to fit your vibe, and you can even pause your ride recordings or add photos to your trip history. We also added Quick-Switch profiles so you can save your favorite settings and swap them instantly. You can now make your profile your own with a bio and a picture, plus we made it even easier to get help through live chat or by finding service locations. Thanks for riding with us. We will see you out there!
results.description:
Welcome to the next generation of the Apollo experience.

We wanted to make your ride even better, so we took everything we learned and rebuilt the Apollo Scooters app from scratch. It is a fresh start designed to be faster to use and more streamlined, so you can spend less time looking at your phone and more time on the road.

Everything you need, in fewer taps. We focused on making the app feel natural and easy. You can connect via Bluetooth and tweak your acceleration or braking exactly how you like it. With the new Profiles feature, you can jump between your favorite scooter settings in a second. Managing your scooter is simple too: register your ride, update firmware, or flag your scooter as stolen if you ever need to, all in one spot.

Your command center. Turn your phone into the ultimate dashboard. Keep an eye on your live speed, battery life, and motor temperature while you are on the move. We have Google Maps integrated right in, so you can navigate without switching apps. You can also pause your rides when you stop for a break and attach photos to your trips to keep a gallery of your adventures.

Get rewarded for riding. Who does not love a little friendly competition? Track your stats to earn AMPs, XP, and Badges just for cruising. See where you stand on the global leaderboard and customize your profile with a photo and bio so the community knows who is who.

We have your back. The app is also your go-to tool for keeping your scooter in top shape. Get quick tips on riding and maintenance, or reach out for help whenever you need it. You can access live chat, submit a ticket, or find a nearby service location in just a few taps.

Why ride with Newt:
- A fun, cheap, and eco-friendly way to transport yourself
- Pay as you go. We won’t charge you for something that you haven't used.
- Safety is our number one priority. We run extensive tests on our scooters and take them to be maintained by experts in the local community in order for you to only worry about having fun!

How to ride:
1. Download the App
2. Find a scooter near you and scan the QR code
3. Start your ride and get to your destination
4. Park in a safe location and lock it
5. Share your experience and get FREE credits!

Try it now!

www.newtmobility.com
support@newtmobility.com

results.description:
Urent – e-scooter and bike share app. If you want to go for a ride with friends or get to your favourite coffee shop quickly and easily – Urent is a service for you! Fast and convenient way to move around the city, hundreds of parking lots where you can rent an electric scooter and leave it afterwards.


It’s simple!
- Download the app and register – it takes a couple of minutes, only a phone number and a bank card are needed.
- Find the nearest e-scooter on the map in the app.
- Scan QR-code on the wheel, choose tariff plan and press "Start"
- Unlock the scooter, push off and press the gas – the lever on the right side of the wheel.
- Hundreds of parking lots to lock the scooter easily and finish the rent.
- Keep an eye on the charge of the scooter to find parking complete the rent in time.
 


MULTI-RENT
Take up to 5 scooters and/or bikes per one account – just rent a few e-scooters or bicycles by scanning their QR-codes.


BOOKING AND STANDBY MODE
Book a bike or electric scooter in the app, and it will wait for you for 10 minutes.
You can close the lock and put the e-scooter in standby mode during rental – rent continues, but the lock will be closed, you can leave for a few minutes without worrying about your scooter safety.



More information about service use terms on our website https://urent.ru/rules/
Service is available in Moscow, St. Petersburg, Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk and the largest cities in the South of Russia, such as Sochi, Krasnaya Polyana, Anapa, Krasnodar, Rostov-on-Don and others. The rental rules may differ for each city, so we recommend checking them before renting. In general, sharing is similar to Whoosh, Eleven, Lite, Busyfly, YES Sharing, Lime, Bird, Dott, Voi, Tier, Circ, EnerGo and others.


E-scooter and bike sharing Urent – simple, pleasant and fast way to get wherever you want!
